_comment: Revision R2.6, R2.8, R3.4: discovery oracle under LR, RF and GBDT on twice as many base states (seeds 0-5; 288 base states x 4 rounds), sharded over n_jobs processes, plus full campaigns on the same states (all strategies, all learners).
